title: Decision: reactions: what counts as one, and the B.2 example without inReplyTo (agent choice, epic mimid-qqtk)
description: mimi-content-10 §5.3, §5.7, Appendix B.2. Chosen: a received message is a reaction when its top disposition is reaction (2), it has inReplyTo and no replaces, and its body is one text/* part or a processAll MultiPart of text/* parts each of disposition reaction, each at most MAX_REACTION_LEN = 64 octets (INVENTED). Anything else (media reactions, too long) stays a message (jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Reactions carries media reactions as replies). Appendix B.2's example has inReplyTo null, so it names nothing to react to: kept as a message; possible WG erratum (label wg candidate). An unlike is any NullPart replacing a reaction message, from its sender; an edit of a reaction is not applied. A reaction to a message not stored is skipped. MAX_REACTIONS_PER_MESSAGE = 1024 INVENTED. Doc: agent-frontends.md §7.27.
